title: Contra III: The Alien Wars
issues: BG3 is filled in the sides: the game uses it for the players' status line and the title menu's text, both laid out for 256 columns on a 32-tile map that would repeat.
The game draws a stage into video RAM only near the SNES picture: ahead of the players the side columns can show another part of the stage (a building, fire) until the game draws there.
The intro's city scene shows a different, ruined city in the sides: the game keeps the next scene's picture there.
